name: Joharabad

queries.query: Joharabad Pakistan cadastral map parcel GIS official land records
queries.result: Search identified the official Punjab PULSE urban land GIS and Punjab Land Records Authority. The PULSE viewer exposed a current official ArcGIS GPC parcel service; the exact point query was empty but a bounded nearby envelope returned three parcel polygons.

queries.query: جوہرآباد پاکستان کادستر نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ سرکاری
queries.result: Native-language search surfaced the official Punjab Land Records Authority and Punjab PULSE GIS routes. It did not independently establish Joharabad-specific coverage; bounded source inspection supplied the service evidence.

portals.name: PULSE Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement GIS
portals.observation: The current viewer HTML exposes the official GPC Parcels ArcGIS MapServer and a public viewer token route. The GPC Parcel layer is polygon geometry, query-capable, and reports EPSG/WKID 4326.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Punjab GPC parcel layer sampled in a bounded envelope around the WUP point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three safe-ID polygon features returned in the envelope 72.2879529336539,32.2718972963112 to 72.3279529336539,32.3118972963112. The exact WUP point returned zero intersecting features. This is not evidence of citywide absence or completeness.

remainingUncertainty: The PULSE/GPC layer returned nearby polygons but did not intersect the exact WUP point. Coverage relation to the Joharabad municipal boundary, parcel-layer completeness, and stable identity guarantees beyond the publisher's GPCParcelId field remain unverified.
sourceQuality: Official Punjab government PULSE GIS and Punjab Land Records Authority ArcGIS service. Native sample identity is GPCParcelId; raw source attributes were not retained in the sample.
